**What is the Role?**

As a final year tertiary student in 2027, gain paid work experience one day per week, to learn about teaching in a Christian school.

This is a contract position commencing Week 1, Term 1 2027 and is **one-day-per-week, term-time only**.

The program has been designed to be completed around your final year of study, to provide you with the opportunity to be a part of the St Andrew’s Cathedral School community and to learn about teaching in a Christian school.

This role offers valuable hands-on experience for tertiary students considering a career in education within a supportive Anglican school environment.

As an Intern, you will be provided with:

* a dedicated Mentor Teacher
* support and oversight of the program(s) by the School Coordinator
* collegial weekly Intern meetings, including devotionals, professional discussions about the development of teaching practice, and reflections on the progression of your individual teaching goals.
* Paid opportunities to attend relevant Professional Learning

**Who will the successful applicant be?**

* A tertiary student in their **final** year in 2027 (Bachelor or Master of Education/ Teaching)
* Possess a genuine interest to learn about teaching in a Christian School
* Able to demonstrate a growing knowledge of recent developments in the theory and practice of pedagogy.
* Display outstanding interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with teachers
* Expected to understand and have a commitment to the School’s Christian mission, values and ethos.
* St Andrew's Cathedral School values the unique perspectives First Nations peoples bring to education and warmly encourages Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates to apply.

**TO APPLY go to - https://www.sacs.nsw.edu.au/join-us/tertiary-student-internship/**

* A 250-word statement of why you would like to be an intern at the School
* Your current CV including your NESA conditional accreditation number
* Two reference letters with one being from the minister of your home church

**Applications close:** 7 November 2026

Interviews will commence as applications are received.

**please note -** St Andrew's Cathedral School reserves the right to close the advertisement prior to closing date if all vacancies are filled.

**For further employment benefits at SACS:** https://www.sacs.nsw.edu.au/employment/

**Who are we?**

St Andrew’s Cathedral School (SACS) is an independent, Kindergarten to Year 12 Anglican school located in two high-rise buildings in the heart of Sydney’s CBD. The school offers students a strong academic program and extensive opportunities to be involved in sport, music, drama and outdoor education. As an authentically Christian school in the Anglican tradition, Christian values are embedded in all aspects of daily life, with honesty, integrity, humility, respect and service being foundational to the richness of relationships at SACS. We seek to develop students who think critically and creatively and have hearts that love, minds that grow and lives that give.

**Why St Andrew's Cathedral School?**

St Andrew’s Cathedral School received Voice Project's Best Workplace Award for staff satisfaction and engagement in 2020, and was recently awarded 5 Star Employer of Choice 2022 by The Educator for positive employee experience. This is an amazing achievement, representative of a supportive, collegiate culture where every staff member is known, valued and equipped to excel in their role.

Prior to employment at the School, this position requires the successful applicant to have a Working with Children Check clearance in accordance with the Child Protection (Working with Children) Act 2012.

For more information on Working with Children Checks, please visit the NSW Office of the Children's Guardian website.

**Main Duties and Responsibilities:**

Arranging support for aged clients with **Vietnamese-speaking backgrounds** at home under the Support at Home Program and/or the Commonwealth Home Support Program (CHSP). This includes:

* Preparing assessments, care plans, client statements, service reports, and claims;
* Communicating with My Aged Care, support workers, and other stakeholders; engaging in networking and service promotion;
* Assisting in daily operations and providing general administrative support to the HAS Unit, including support to other team members, team leaders, and supervisors;
* Embedding the Statement of Rights, dignity of risk, and Aged Care Quality Standards into all care services;
* Confirming eligibility, completing onboarding tasks, delivering Support Plan Review processes, and maintaining accurate records;
* Monitoring budgets, Assistive Technology and Home Modifications pathways, and ensuring compliance with program rules and claiming requirements; and
* Promoting wellness and reablement approaches, empowering clients to make informed decisions and maintain independence.

**Selection Criteria:**

**Essential**

* Tertiary qualification and/or experience in relevant field;
* Good command of spoken and written English;
* Must be able to speak and write Vietnamese fluently;
* Good communication, interpersonal, time management, and organisational skills;
* Ability to pay attention to details;
* Computer literate;
* Ability to work as a team and independently;
* Current First Aid Certificate or is able to obtain the certificates prior to employment;
* Valid National Police Certificate or is able to obtain the certificates prior to employment; and
* Valid driver’s licence and access to vehicle covered by comprehensive car insurance.

**Desirable**

* Relevant qualifications (Certificate IV or Diploma in Community Services or Aged Care preferred)
* Relevant knowledge and experience in aged care services and Aged Care Quality Standards;
* Previous experience in aged care case management (Home Care Packages/CHSP); and
* Ability to speak other languages.

**YOUR IMPACT**
  
  
Are you passionate about research and generating investment ideas? We’re looking for a professional to join our REITs sector team in Sydney, to develop valuable insights and investment ideas for our clients.

**OUR IMPACT**
  
  
From macroeconomic forecasts to individual stock analysis, our team develops tools and insights to help shape investment strategies for clients and the firm. Our analysts work on client-focused research in the equity, fixed-income, currency, and commodities markets, mining big data that enters markets around the world each day to identify game-changing insights. You’ll be part of a team that is intellectually curious, creative, analytical, and passionate about performing market research.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**

* Providing support to single stock research analyst
* Building, maintaining, and updating company forecast and valuation models
* Analyzing market share, macro trend, and cross company and sub sector data analysis
* Write research notes on companies under coverage
* Working on company / sector-specific projects
* Conducting statistical analysis of economic data, fundamentals, and relevant correlations of the data
* Update monthly reports and marketing presentations
* Working closely with Content Management Group to ensure timely publication of research reports
Respond to ad hoc requests from clients, sales, and traders  

**SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

* University degree (finance, accounting major preferable)
* More than 1 year of relevant work experience – preferably looking at the REITs / Real Estate subsector, or working at major REITs covering investment or strategy
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and creative skills
* Excellent Financial modeling and numerical skills
* Ability to work/conduct independently and with limited supervision
Meticulous attention to detail, strong analytical and organizational skills  

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Strong ability to perform financial statement, business, and valuation analysis
* Comparable business/financial/consulting experience preferred
* Demonstrated ability to think laterally and exercise good judgment
* Self-starter attitude with high level of enthusiasm for equity research
Natural curiosity, critical thinking, logical thinking

Current university students and recent graduates.

You will gain hands-on experience with high-throughput transaction systems, distributed architectures, payment processing, and financial infrastructure.
